items.stem: A company has a detailed written compliance policy but employees routinely ignore it and leadership never references it. Against the elements of an effective program, what is the core deficiency?

options.text: Lack of oversight, culture and enforcement making the program ineffective in practice
options.rationale: Correct: an effective program requires genuine oversight, culture and enforcement, not just documents.

options.text: The policy is simply too long
options.rationale: Length is not the governing deficiency here.

options.text: Nothing, because a written policy satisfies the standard
options.rationale: A written policy alone does not make a program effective.
Adding documents does not fix a culture-and-enforcement gap.

items.explanation: Correct: an effective program requires genuine oversight, culture and enforcement, not just documents.

items.stem: When conducting a compliance risk assessment, what makes the output most useful for program design?

options.text: Prioritising risks by likelihood and impact so resources target the highest exposure
options.rationale: Correct: a risk-ranked assessment directs limited resources to the greatest exposure.

options.text: Listing every conceivable risk without prioritisation
options.rationale: An unranked list does not guide resource allocation.

options.text: Copying another company's risk register unchanged
options.rationale: Risk is entity-specific; a copied register may miss real exposures.

options.text: Assessing risk only after an incident occurs

items.explanation: Correct: a risk-ranked assessment directs limited resources to the greatest exposure.

items.stem: A whistleblower reports suspected kickbacks. Which TWO actions best protect the integrity of the compliance response? (Select TWO)

options.rationale: Correct: anti-retaliation protection is essential to an effective reporting mechanism.

options.text: Preserve relevant documents and plan an impartial investigation
options.rationale: Correct: document preservation and impartial investigation protect integrity.

options.text: Tell the accused manager to handle it informally
options.rationale: Letting the subject manage the inquiry destroys independence.

options.text: Close the matter quickly to avoid disruption
options.rationale: Rushing to close undermines a credible investigation.

options.text: Identify the reporter to the accused to 'clear the air'

items.explanation: Correct: anti-retaliation protection is essential to an effective reporting mechanism. Correct: document preservation and impartial investigation protect integrity.
